content_of_post_to_comment: I’m curious about this. What’s a book you read when you were young that has stayed with you for reasons you can’t entirely explain? Not necessarily the best book you ever read. Not necessarily a classic. Just one that somehow lodged itself in there and never left. I’m especially interested in the odd ones.
comment: Maybe the odd books stay with us because we encountered them before we had the language to explain what felt strange about them. We remember the unease long after forgetting the plot.
